_comment: Shared contract for the composer's markdown image DESTINATION grammar, which
writes it into the wire text as `![image](<dest>)`) and
must recognise that exact spelling to rewrite an inlined picture's line to
its `[image: <name>]` marker and to see, on a queued edit, that the user
removed a picture whose destination the composer had to escape). The
=== dest for every case; the BACKEND test (test/test_prompt_attachments.py)
asserts markdown_image_dest(path) == dest for the same cases. A change to
either implementation that is not mirrored in the other goes red HERE
instead of silently keeping a deleted picture in the turn. Each case names
the shape it pins; `path` is the local path exactly as the composer holds
it (Windows separators are single backslashes in the JSON string).

cases.name: angle brackets are backslash-escaped and wrapped
drive letter with a space is forward-slashed and wrapped
a posix backslash is not a separator
non-ascii letters are not plain (js \w is ascii) so the dest is wrapped
